name: algorithmic-art
tagline_zh: 想要独一无二的生成艺术？用种子随机数，每次运行都是新画作。拖动参数，实时探索形态，不复制大师，只创造你的宇宙。
tagline_en: Seeded randomness, interactive sliders—every run is a unique generative artwork. Explore flow fields & particles.
desc_en: Creating algorithmic art using p5.js with seeded randomness and interactive parameter exploration. Use this when users request creating art using code, generative art, algorithmic art, flow fields, or particle systems. Create original algorithmic art rather than copying existing artists' work to avoid copyright violations.
why_zh: 种子随机数让作品可复现，参数探索面板让调整即时可见，比纯随机更可控，比手写代码更直观。
why_en: Seeded randomness ensures reproducibility, while interactive parameter exploration gives instant visual feedback—more control.
